title: tests/kernel/run_kernel_tests.sh: kernel test orchestrator
description: Shell script that orchestrates loading and running all kernel test modules. Usage: sudo ./run_kernel_tests.sh /path/to/wolfcrypt.ko /path/to/wolfkm.ko. Procedure: (1) insmod wolfcrypt.ko, insmod wolfkm.ko; (2) for each test_*.ko: build if needed, insmod, sleep 2, capture dmesg since load, grep for PASS/FAIL lines, rmmod; (3) collect pass/fail counts; (4) rmmod wolfkm.ko, rmmod wolfcrypt.ko; (5) exit nonzero if any FAIL.
design: Color output: green PASS, red FAIL, yellow SKIP. 30-second timeout per test module (kill and fail if exceeded). dmesg filtering: capture lines with 'wolfkm_test' prefix to distinguish from unrelated kernel messages. After all tests, check dmesg for 'BUG:' or 'Oops:' — fail the run if found. Used by tests/ci/test-on-aws.sh.
